Chapter 7198: Strongest Powers In The Future

Chapter 7198: Strongest Powers In The Future

Despite an internal sense of uncertainty brewing, Genesis had no other choice.

“This future can’t be changed by you or me, Sir, you will see the strongest power soon.” He said.

“You don’t know what karma is then.” Li Qiye said: “But it doesn’t matter since I can doodle even karma.”

Although the group understood what he meant and felt unease, they still chose to move forward.

“Activate!” The group released tribulations into Heavencrush, activating it.

The machine, once empowered, could copy and duplicate anything. However, it opened the seal and took in the cloud.

Its power erupted to an unfathomable level, transforming into a temporal pulse heading toward the future. It resembled a colorful rainbow connecting the present and future.

When the gate to the future opened, the present could peer into the future and even interfere with it. The future naturally couldn’t allow this to happen, or as time rippled outward, the present would replace the future.

The rule of the future would inevitably descend upon the present to set things right. All possible deviations must be isolated and corrected.

“Pop!” A supreme and immemorial force emerged.

“Sir, now you face the future and its greatest power.” Genesis staked everything on this final gamble.

“Boom!” Starlight cascaded, heralding a figure.

It did not seem human, yet it was filled with life and compassion. All living beings were bathed in love as if this was how it should be. Their actions were judged by their conscience and something higher. The key was that all lives should love and be loved.

Only primordial immortals and up could see the outline of this colossal being. They saw semblances of a beautiful woman. However, this beauty didn’t come from appearance but rather, love and benevolence. This beauty was completely different from Phoenix Queen’s beauty.

Observers couldn’t imagine this lifeform. Was it a human, a demon, or something else entirely?

“Boom!” The figure pushed away all worlds from her and Li Qiye with one wave.

Most importantly, this didn’t harm worlds to everyone’s astonishment.

“How can such a being be possible?” Phoenix Queen murmured.

She raised her hand again and removed everything around Li Qiye. This ultimate control was beyond the high heaven’s mastery.

She then created a battlefield with new powers - determination, love, mercy, pity, conscience, guidance... Was this an insight into the future world?

As Li Qiye stood there, he seemed to have lost his power. She delivered a strike of determination against him, forcing him to block with both hands.

The strike broke through everything and drove him into countless dimensions, pinning him down.

“Rise!” He smiled and lifted the unknown force.

However, the second strike came - a supreme judgment of heaven and earth. This was akin to a mortal being trapped beneath a mountain.

“Good!” Li Qiye laughed after being immobilized and unleashed his eternal will, pushing the figure away.

She retaliated with boundless love and mercy, capable of enveloping all worlds. Malice and destruction became useless. Thus, even Li Qiye’s will couldn’t overcome this ultimate defense.

“Bam!” Li Qiye was pushed down again, unable to get up.

“We did it!” Phoenix Queen and the others celebrated.

“What is this thing?!” Empress Hong Tian, Li Baye, and their allies couldn’t believe it.

These future powers somehow overwhelmed Li Qiye. This surpassed anything the high heaven could do.

As for Li Qiye, he showed no sign of panic. Instead, a faint smile appeared on his face - one of satisfaction like a master admiring his perfect work of art.
